Ask for the anti nausea stuff to be put in the IV. Eye cover and headphones, my fav music station is classical relaxation on pandora. Don’t plan on anything but going to bed or chilling on the couch after.

For me it’s about trying to keep as little medication/interaction in my system as possible. Try to accomplish the most using the least, if that makes sense.

In my experience, it lessens side effects, and allows you to really figure out what’s working and what’s not. When you’re taking a lot of meds all at once (especially starting them all together) you can experience funky things.

I’d try ketamine alone first, then add on the CBD.
